message.reasoning_content:
Round 4, license auction. Expected license income ~20-60 alashi (~40 avg). Bank commission? Payouts proportional... bidding makes sense up to expected value minus share. If I don't bid, license goes to rival. My share weight 50:30:15 — I'm probably the biggest. If I bid A and win, I get license income L plus my share. Net gain vs losing: license income L minus bid A (bid goes to bank, but bank is distributed back...). Bid goes to bank, which is distributed — so partially refunded. So bid close to expected L is fine. Expected L ~40 alashi (avg). Bid maybe 25-30M = 25-30 alashi. Also competitors may bid. Bid 30M (30000000).

Also president with veto — but that's law phase. Bid 30000000.
